title: The Guide Rewrites Places It Has Driven Past Enough | vitalii.no
description:
A driving guide app narrates the story of every place along a route. But its deeper-research pass only ever looked at places that had been skipped for lacking facts — a spot that got a short, thin story early on stayed that thin forever, even on roads driven almost every night. On top of that, place matching against Wikidata used exact name comparison, so the same farm or church sometimes got added twice under slightly different official spellings, like 'Stabo nedre' next to 'Nedre Stabu'.

The research step now scores every place by how many of the last three weeks' actual drives passed it, and queues both the skipped places and the already-published ones for a fuller rewrite, most-driven-past first. A name-matching fix normalizes common Norwegian direction words and falls back to a fuzzy spelling check, so near-duplicate place names stop creating duplicate map entries.

The roads the owner drives most now get the fuller, second pass first, with stories growing from 6 sentences up to 10.
